turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress document to floor]
    C --> D[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    D --> E["This is a finding, not a draft."]

    B -->|Draft prompt| F{Mode stated or inferable?}
    F -->|No| G[Ask for mode]
    G --> F
    F -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| H[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    H -->|HUMAN| I[Run the speak test]
    H -->|MACHINE| J[Continue]
    I --> J

    J --> K{Floor passes?}
    K -->|No| L{How many gaps?}
    L -->|Three or fewer| M[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    L -->|Four or more| N[Ask three largest gaps and state assumptions]
    M --> J
    N --> J

    K -->|Yes| O[Compress the prompt]
    O --> P{Cut removed specification?}
    P -->|Yes| Q[Name decorative or destructive cut and revert]
    Q --> O
    P -->|No| R{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    R -->|No| S{Floor still passes?}
    S -->|No| T[Return last passing version]
    S -->|Yes| O
    R -->|Yes| U[Contract is minimal]
    T --> U
    U --> V[Output optimized prompt and cut note]
    V --> W["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]

    W -->|Keep negotiating| O
    W -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| X{Human named signer?}
    X -->|No| Y[Gate stays closed]
    X -->|Yes| Z{Execution tools available?}
    Z -->|No| Y
    Z -->|Yes| AA["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    AA --> AB{Result}
    AB -->|Success| AC[Done]
    AB -->|Floor item fails| AD["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    AD --> O
```
